chunks: When a man is given a daughter, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sends to her an angel, who passes his wing over her head and chest and says: 'A fragile being created from weakness; whoever spends on her will be aided.'

key_terms.الْمُنْفِقُ: the one who spends or provides
key_terms.جَنَاحَهُ: his wing, symbolizing gentleness and care
key_terms.ضَعْفٍ: weakness, the state from which she was created

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the virtue of having and supporting a daughter?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue and tenderness associated with having a daughter, presenting her as deserving of special divine care. It also encourages supporting and providing for daughters by promising Allah’s assistance to the one who does so.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4700 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"When a man is blessed with a daughter, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, sends an angel to her who passes his wing over her head and chest and says, 'A fragile being created from weakness; whoever provides for her will be assisted.'"
